properties.summary: Accepted lane 02b's partial refutations: redaction of remote credentials happens at construction (the id is committed into cursors, so print-time redaction is too late); cross-replica add/add conflicts are resolved keep-ours-and-retain-theirs (never checkout --ours, which loses a side); same-digest/different-signature duplicates are decided by which signature verifies (no timing input), not by a widened journal primary key that would break existing rows.
